answers: DIRECTOR-DISPATCH-BC-20260728-1520 §4 — the cache-stamp bump is INSIDE the train
why_this_file_exists: The seal pins source bytes. The cache stamp is not a source byte in this train,
it is a build argument, so sealing the sources did not put it inside the train.
Building strictly from the sealed set produced the hazard: with BUILD_ID unset,
bump-dist-v9-cache.mjs:73 increments the COMMITTED stamp, so this branch yields
20260724b62 — behind the 20260727b80 already served. Correct bytes, cached URL.
SAFE-01 applies to this file too: a build parameter that is only written down is
not enforced. record-build refuses any id not ahead of the floor below.
build_command: docker compose build --build-arg CHECKPOINT_BUILD=1 --build-arg CHART_BUILD_ID=20260728b81 --build-arg SOURCE_COMMIT_SHA=b6d94c767892c7134cd1e4b45c9f85a18e5bbb95 homepage trading-chart

stamp_floor.meaning: highest stamp known to have been served; a build id must be strictly ahead of it
stamp_floor.enforced_by: seal-evidence.mjs record-build — refuses at or below the floor
stamp_floor.not_enforced_by: the image build itself; checkpoint-build-assert.mjs validates SHAPE only, never ordering

chosen_stamp_rationale: 20260728b81 is ahead of the floor on both the date field and the sequence field.
Confirmed absent from `git log --all -S`, so it cannot collide with a warm cache entry.

no_source_edit_required.reason: homepage/Dockerfile:17 sets ENV BUILD_ID=${CHART_BUILD_ID}, and resolveBuildId consults BUILD_ID before the committed-stamp path, so the divergent committed b61 is overridden inside the image.
no_source_edit_required.territory_note: All four shells that load order-manager.js belong to Manager A. The build-arg path needs none of them edited.

covered_by_the_build_arg_path: homepage/public/chart/* copies, overwritten from source at image build
still_not_enforced_anywhere: Nothing fails the IMAGE BUILD when a module's content changes and its ?v= does not.
record-build catches it only after the fact, and only for this train.
The general gate is Manager C's C-NEXT cache-stamp coherence gate.
